wiring.promotion: A requested (symbol, channel) advances WARMING_UP -> FRESH ONLY on real data arrival for that channel (per-channel, independent).

coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.note: These stages are STRICTLY DISTINCT; registration count MUST NOT be read as operational coverage.
coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.registered: 5615 (tradable master; native symbol ids/generations allocated up front)
coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.historically_warmed: <= CENGINE_WARMUP_MAX_SYMBOLS (default 500), prioritized: positions -> pending -> references -> actionable -> preliminary -> remaining; one-shot threaded at startup.
coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.subscribed: per-channel caps bars<=4096, trades<=1000, quotes<=250 on the ONE SIP socket; tiered.
coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.observed: subset of subscribed that actually ticks (drives WARMING_UP->FRESH per channel).
coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.feature_valid: subset with enough bar history for Wilder DMI/ADX/VWAP/BB (screen tech_valid flags).
coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.screened: subset flagged SCREEN_ENTRY_QUALIFIED by the mandatory entry contract.
coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.ranked: screened candidates scored by GPU rank_candidates (CPU-parity).
coverage_funnel_distinct_stages.actionable_published: canonical universe.txt currently 31 symbols (v1) — the published actionable set, NOT the master universe.
